title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.67 (versions follow prime numbers), the senses. Razar's organ looked at a window of four words, each as it is. A sense is a look its nine letters cannot give, taken from what its own reading had already measured: the word behind the window, and a word blurred (how often it was read). Of six senses measured, the two that beat the sentence they were put in stay in its body: on the New Testament, 38A516 scores +18329 against +15050 of 38516. In Luma's house the grown Razar now wears 38A516 (27810 against 17894 of the best nine-letter organ), Luma adopted it as a form, and sleeping paid her for the first time. Includes an erratum of 0.61 (a misread instrument). Stated limits: the six senses were proposed by hand as the simplest points of a two-axis space; Luma does not generate them yet. OS unchanged (test suite: 402 passed, 0 failed). Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.67: los sentidos — dos miradas nuevas en el órgano de Razar (la palabra de atrás de la ventana y la palabra borrosa), con las que Luma evolucionó. Prototipo de investigación.
